snapshot.scope: Public work groups returned for the stated ORCID iD; count establishes attribution and availability only.

orcid.role: Persistent researcher identity and public work index

zenodo.role: Formal public repository and DOI source

research_breadth.method: Separate observation, interpretation and hypothesis; connect each proposition to an attributable source, a testable next step and an explicit stopping condition.
research_breadth.review_posture: Public records establish authorship and availability. Independent challenge, reproduction and domain-qualified review remain the relevant proof gates.
research_breadth.translation_gate: Research enters a company proposition only when the use case, authority boundary, test method and evidence required for a bounded evaluation are explicit.

evidence_boundary: A public ORCID, Zenodo or ResearchGate record establishes attribution and source availability only. It does not establish peer review, independent scientific or engineering validation, product readiness, commercial performance, customer adoption, funding or endorsement.
